swap_risks: CRITICAL SUPPLY VOLTAGE RATING: TLV9002IDR is limited to 5.5 V max (7 V abs max, p.14) whereas MC33202DR2G supports up to 12 V (13 V abs max, p.3). Installing a 5.5 V CMOS part on a 12 V–24 V rail causes instant breakdown.

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 16000x (MC33202DR2G: 80000 pA p.3 vs TLV9002IDR: 5 pA p.17); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 15x (MC33202DR2G: 900 µA/ch p.4 vs TLV9002IDR: 60 µA/ch p.18); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TLV9002IDR has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (7 V, p.14) than MC33202DR2G (13 V, p.3); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 7 V.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (MC33202DR2G: -40..105 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to 105°C) vs TLV9002IDR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to 125°C)); MC33202DR2G hot limit only 105 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: MC33202DR2G (onsemi, SOIC-8) and TLV9002IDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because supply voltage Vs,max drops >=20%; input bias current Ib differs 16000x (CMOS vs bipolar input stage); quiescent supply current Iq/ch differs 15x. Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 2.2 MHz (p.4) vs 1 MHz (p.17), supply ceiling 12 V (p.1) vs 5.5 V (p.14), Vos 8 mV (p.3) vs 1.6 mV (p.17), Ib 16000x gap (80000 vs 5 pA), voltage noise 20 vs 30 nV/√Hz. Primary bench gotchas to watch: MC33202DR2G "Internal Back-to-Back Differential Input Clamp Diodes Limit Comparator Use" (p.3) and TLV9002IDR "5.5 V Max Supply Limit vs Pin-Identical High-Voltage SOIC-8 Op-Amps" (p.14). BOM decision: Choose MC33202DR2G when supply rails exceed 5.5 V (rated up to 12 V) or closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 2.2 MHz GBWP; choose TLV9002IDR when DC precision demands <= 1.6 mV max Vos or high-impedance sensors require pA-class input bias (5 pA). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.8) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
